posts.title: Building an assistant made for an audience of one
posts.description: Nobody asked for this, and that's the point I built a personal assistant for exactly one user. Me. There's no pricing page, no waitlist, no plan to turn it into a startup. It runs on my workstation, talks to models on my own hardware, and knows about my calendar, my notes, my projects and the handful of services I keep running at home.
